title: Kosgei sets Chinese all-comers' record of 2:16:36 at Shanghai Marathon
claims: The Shanghai Marathon was a World Athletics Platinum Label road race held on Sunday 30 November 2025.
Brigid Kosgei won the women's race in 2:16:36, the fastest time ever recorded in China; Irine Cheptai was second in 2:18:51 and Tiruye Mesfin third in 2:20:38.
Milkesa Mengesha won the men's race in 2:06:25, ahead of Dawit Wolde in 2:06:27 and Deresa Geleta in 2:06:36, for an Ethiopian podium sweep.
Kosgei passed 10 km in 32:25 and 30 km in 1:37:08.
The men's lead group passed 10 km in 29:27 and 30 km in 1:30:14.
Kosgei becomes only the second woman in the history of the race to win in Shanghai.
